name: cortex-agent
description: VS Code extension for Cortex Hub — real-time agent orchestration via WebSocket conductor

commands.title: Cortex: Reset This Window's Agent and Key

cortexHub.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for Cortex Hub authentication. Resolution order: the key set for this window in the Agent Panel (kept in the OS keychain), this setting, then `CORTEX_HUB_API_KEY` / `HUB_API_KEY` / `CORTEX_API_KEY` env vars, then MCP configs (Claude Code, `.mcp.json`, Gemini, Antigravity `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code). Two windows that need two agents: set a key per window in the Agent Panel instead of here.

cortexHub.hubUrl.markdownDescription: Cortex Hub conductor WebSocket URL. Resolution order: this setting, then `CORTEX_HUB_WS_URL` / `CORTEX_HUB_URL` env vars, then MCP configs (Claude Code, `.mcp.json`, Gemini, Antigravity, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code), then `ws://localhost:8318/ws/conductor`.

cortexHub.agentId.markdownDescription: Agent identifier sent to the conductor. Defaults to `<hostname>-<ide>`. The name set for a window in the Agent Panel wins over this setting. Two windows with the same id replace each other, so give each window its own name there.

cortexHub.capabilities.markdownDescription: Agent capabilities to register with the conductor. The Agent Panel can set them per window.

cortexHub.autoConnect.markdownDescription: Automatically connect to Hub on startup.

scripts.release: npm version patch && npm run build && npm run package
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run build && npm run package
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run build && npm run package
